correctness.rationale: For complex flags of block type (1,a,b), the pullbacks of the line and Grassmannian Plücker bundles give weight λ=(2,1^a,0^b). Borel–Weil identifies the Hilbert function for nonnegative tensor powers with the dimension of the representation of highest weight mλ (duality does not affect dimension). Only roots between distinct blocks contribute to the leading term, N=ab+a+b in all. The roots from the first coordinate contribute 2^b/(a+b)!; for each of the a remaining nonzero coordinates the roots to the last block contribute r!/(b+r)! with r ranging from 0 to a−1. Multiplication by N! gives the claimed degree. The affine Schubert cells contribute one each to the topological Euler characteristic, which is (a+b+1)!/(a!b!). For R=D/E the a increment gives ∏_{j=1}^{b+1}(N+j)/(a+1+j), and the b increment gives 2∏_{j=1}^{a+1}(N+j)/(b+1+j), by factorial cancellation. The numerator terms exceed the denominator terms by b(a+1)−1 and a(b+1)−1 respectively. Both are positive, and R(1,1)=6/6, proving the unique equality at (n,k)=(3,2) without finite extrapolation. Checked sample values (D,E)=(40,12), (20,12) at (4,2), (4,3). Inspected the bundled checker but did not execute it. Other flag types and polarizations are outside the result.
